subject: One type hint broke MCP tools. · Agent traps 14
title: One type hint broke MCP tools. · Agent traps 14
description:
Fixed in mcp python-sdk v2.1.0 (PR #3331).
One type hint broke MCP tools. Fixed upstream. Sources:
https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk/issues/3227
https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk/pull/3331
https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk/releases/tag/v2.1.0
script: One type hint broke MCP tools. On Python three ten, a tool that returns a TypedDict with a NotRequired key failed at registration, before it ever ran. Pydantic called the annotation invalid. Python three eleven and up were fine. Update the MCP Python SDK. Registration works, and optional keys are left out instead of sent as null. Exact version in the description. Old Python in prod? Test registration there. Subscribe — next agent trap.
